research_experiences.name: NYU Courant
research_experiences.description:

Termolator
, an automatic NLP system for domain-specific terminology extraction, and
TERM-SCORE

interns.name: Alibaba Group
interns.description:
- Built a full-stack avatar generation system on
Stable Diffusion 1.5
, implementing
T2I
and
img2img
pipelines with dual inference backends including local SD and ComfyUI, while benchmarking the performance and hardware requirements of mainstream open-source models including SD and Flux. - Deployed Hy-MT2-7B and Qwen3-4B to translate structured image parameters and user prompts into diffusion prompts, and designed
incremental semantic merging strategies
to resolve style and feature conflicts when multiple parameters were combined. - Optimized denoising strength thresholds for img2img iteration and classified editing instructions into addition, replacement, deletion, and retention, prioritizing retention of unrelated subject details to mitigate feature drift and error accumulation across multi-round edits. - Conducted
full-scene testing
and
iterative optimization
of the multimodal generation system, drew comparative conclusions across prompt merging strategies, and built conflict resolution mechanisms based on hard constraints and users' latest intentions, verifying improved stability through regression testing.

Cleaned
time series device data; constructed data anomaly detection and localization algorithms to locate and process abnormal data using

in

device data. - Wrote Python automation script for timed processing of device data, handled timed database read/write using

interns.name: China Cinda Asset Management Co., Ltd
interns.description:
- Synthesized industry and internal case materials on distressed asset resolution (e.g., debt-to-equity swaps, auctions, restructurings) and distilled key risk factors into reusable briefings for internal reference.
- Compiled and standardized annual report data across 18 financial institutions including banks, AMCs and brokers, extracting and consolidating key financial and disclosure items into structured datasets for analysis.
- Performed basic cross-company and time-series comparisons (leverage, liquidity, profitability quality, impairments, contingencies) and drafted concise risk highlights to support internal documentation.
- Operated under strict data-access and compliance constraints, focusing on public disclosures and documentation workflows to improve traceability and retrieval efficiency.
